evidence_scope: Beam-width convergence of the SARS-CoV-2 genome's ensemble free energy (Gensemble), supporting the new Results §3.3 figure. Methodological consistency check, not an accuracy claim (no exact genome-scale reference exists).
conclusion: Gensemble decreases monotonically with beam width, with clearly diminishing increments (-813 kcal/mol from b=5 to 10, -257 from b=50 to 100, -169 from b=100 to 200 -- a 34% smaller step despite spanning twice the beam-width range). Not fully plateaued by beam=200, but the deceleration indicates the ensemble is approaching convergence, consistent with the same qualitative behavior reported for LinearCapR's own beam-width diagnostic (Otagaki2026-ev, Figure 7) on the same genome.
